+# Z19 相机阶段交付（2026-10-10）
+
+已完成单路 FL0214/IMX214 的 Linux 1920×1080 采集和电脑实时观看。
+实测 30.047 秒接收 757 张不同的全尺寸 JPEG，约 **25.16 fps**；用户已确认可用并同意相机阶段收尾。
+该成果没有包含目标识别、语音或真实手控制。
+
+## 工程与功能说明
+
+| 路径 | 功能及关键注释所在位置 |
+|---|---|
+| `fpga/camera_hw/` | 原相机 XPR/BD/XDC、所需 CSI/Bayer/Gamma IP、已验证 bit/XSA；README 和 manifest 说明来源/版本/hash |
+| `fpga/camera_baremetal/` | 历史 JTAG 源码、链接脚本、对应 ELF、独立旧 ELF/符号；README 按函数说明用途及复现边界 |
+| `host/camera_linux/ah_camera0.c` / `ah_camera0_uapi.h` | DMA32 三帧、排他设备、只读 mmap、START/STOP/STATUS ABI 和 fd/VMA 生命周期；源码注释说明 halt 失败处理 |
+| `host/camera_linux/capture_camera0.c` / `sensor_table.h` | 传感器初始化、真实帧预热、手动焦距、采样与正常退出；结束先停 DMA 再释放映射 |
+| `host/camera_linux/camera_preview.c` / `.h` | 四段复制完整帧、两个 JPEG worker、30 ms 复制保护、RAM 编码/递增发布和丢弃计数；注释说明固定 profile 限制 |
+| `host/camera_linux/preview_server.py` / `start_preview.py` | 高清 MJPEG、启停/焦距 API、过期画面关闭和拒绝、脱离 SSH 启动 |
+| `host/camera_linux/view_camera.py` | PC 本地 HTTP 入口直连板端固定路由，避免系统代理影响；不改系统网络设置 |
+| `host/camera_linux/test_device.py` / `test_preview.py` / `test_stream.py` | 设备生命周期、故障恢复、逐张 JPEG 解码/序号/接收帧率验收 |
+| `host/camera_linux/validated/` | 最终板端 ELF/模块的字节归档及适用内核说明 |
+| `host/scripts/` | Linux 诊断、受保护 rootfs 安装/收尾、恢复环境、相机 profile 加载 |
+| `tools/build_z19_sd.py` / `z19_image_formats.py` | 原文件 hash 核对、FDT/FIT/CPIO/boot.scr 生成，不在 PC 执行板端程序 |
+| `tools/prepare_z19_sd.ps1` / `clear_z19_sd.ps1` | 显式 SD 身份/几何/参数检查及授权执行；保护系统盘，不自动选择另一张卡 |
+| `tools/capture_z19_uart.ps1` | 串口记录，辅助定位首次启动/安装问题 |
+| `docs/fpga/evidence/2026-10-10/` | 高清流、故障测试、十分钟采集和部署 hash 的原始 JSON 指标 |
+
+以上是已有功能说明，不修改经过验证的 PL 参数、传感器值或手控制协议。
+供方工程保持原字节/版权；仅归档实际依赖的配置与源码，没有收录 build cache/DCP。
+
+## 其他成员复现
+
+1. 从本交付分支获取工程，先读 [硬件说明](../../fpga/camera_hw/README.md)。已验证 bit/XSA 可用；
+   可编辑源工程需要 Vivado 2020.2。现有本机只有 2020.1，本次没有重新综合/实现，不承诺源工程重建 bit 字节相同。
+2. 准备同一 Z19 SD Linux 基线和自己的账号/SSH 认证；原 `BOOT.BIN/image.ub/rootfs.tar.gz` 不在 Git。
+   [SD 部署记录](linux_sd_bringup.md) 与脚本保留其预期 hash。磁盘写入脚本绑定已核实的本机 SD 身份，
+   其他卡必须先人工核实身份/几何并按授权调整，不可直接绕过拒绝检查。
+3. 参考 [Linux 编译说明](../../host/camera_linux/README.md)，复制相机源文件、配套二进制及 loader 到板端。
+   可使用 `validated/` 中当前内核对应的 ELF/模块，或在隔离的内核 build tree 编译；不要在 PC 安装板端包。
+4. 按硬件 README 将 bit 转换为已知 hash 的 raw firmware，确认 PS 时钟/HP1 和无占用后执行 loader。
+   板端运行 `python3 start_preview.py`，PC 运行 `python host/camera_linux/view_camera.py`。
+5. 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8766/`，操作详见 [快速操作](camera_quickstart.md)。
+   当前固定直连地址为 PC `192.28.14.152` / Z19 `192.28.14.153`；SSH 私钥与密码只保存在各自本机。
+
+## 验证与剩余边界
+
+SD 正常系统登录、一轮断电启动、直连 SSH/SCP/hash 已通过；不是三轮冷启动验收。
+Linux 600 秒采集 DMA 错误/空样本为零，故障测试和最终高清流逐帧解码通过，详见
+[验收记录](linux_camera0_bringup.md) 和 [JSON 证据说明](evidence/2026-10-10/README.md)。
+交付前 PC 的 9 项 SD Python 测试、12 项 PowerShell 拒绝检查、standalone 重新编译、脚本语法和归档 hash 核对通过。
+Linux C 曾在板端以 `-Wall -Wextra -Werror` 编译并实机运行；此次归档二进制 hash 与最终部署一致。
+
+约 25 fps 是当前场景的电脑接收结果，页面可显示实际发布速率；不保证固定 30 fps 或无传感器丢帧。
+焦距是手动位置；光学雾感/颜色/标定、第二路、相机开机自动加载及冷启动、识别模型和手控制为后续任务。
+重启后仍需手动加载相机 profile。系统镜像、现场照片/raw/视频、缓存及登录凭据保留本机。

+# Z19 相机快速操作
+
+2026-10-10 定版：第一路 IMX214，真实 **1920×1080** MJPEG，当前实景电脑端约 **25 fps**。
+用户已确认预览可用。画面未做识别或手控制；焦距、雾感和标定仍需后续处理。
+
+## 当前直接观看
+
+打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8766/**，刷新页面后可点“全屏”。
+“启动/停止”控制相机采集；焦距为 0～1023 手动位置，不是自动对焦。
+单次采集最多一小时，结束后再点“启动”。
+
+网络保持电脑网口直连 Z19 PS 网口：PC `192.28.14.152`，板卡 `192.28.14.153`。
+本地入口解决 Windows 代理绕行问题，不需要路由器；Wi-Fi 和系统代理沿用原配置。
+
+## 电脑预览入口关闭后
+
+在电脑 PowerShell 执行，保持该终端运行：
+
+```powershell
+python F:\Amazing_Hand\host\camera_linux\view_camera.py
+```
+
+然后打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8766/`。Ctrl+C 只停止电脑入口，板端服务继续运行。
+若端口已被当前预览入口占用，直接打开页面，勿重复启动。
+
+## 板端服务停止后
+
+相机 PL/驱动仍已加载时，从电脑启动板端服务：
+
+```powershell
+ssh -F F:/Amazing_Hand/tmp/z19-ssh-rsa-config-20261010 z19-direct 'export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin; python3 /opt/amazinghand/camera0-linux-hd-20261010/start_preview.py'
+```
+
+SSH 配置和专用私钥只保存在本机被忽略的 `tmp`，不要提交或分享私钥。
+启动 helper 打印 PID/日志路径，SSH 退出后继续运行，已有 server 时拒绝重复启动。
+仅采集停止时直接在页面点“启动”，无需重启 server。
+
+## 板卡重新通电后
+
+当前 SD 仍加载原基线 PL，**相机没有设置开机自动加载**。
+先通过上面的 SSH 配置登录，在板端执行：
+
+```sh
+export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
+cd /opt/amazinghand/camera0-linux-hd-20261010
+sh /opt/amazinghand/bin/load_z19_camera0.sh \
+  /lib/firmware/amazinghand-camera-28e1e3e7-20261010.bin ./ah_camera0.ko
+python3 start_preview.py
+```
+
+这套加载步骤只用于重启后、当前没有相机 module/采集用户时。
+运行中不要再次编程 PL；loader 会检查配套 hash、时钟、PS 接口和占用。
+若任何检查失败，保留输出诊断，不跳过保护条件。
+
+## 资料入口

+- 源码、编译与生命周期：[camera_linux/README](../../host/camera_linux/README.md)。
+- 采集、流畅度、故障测试和限制：[相机验收记录](linux_camera0_bringup.md)。

+# 相机实测证据
+
+这些 JSON 保存各轮实际测试指标，不含照片/raw、密码或 SSH 私钥。
+
+| 文件 | 证据范围 |
+|---|---|
+| `hd-stream-guard30-validation-20261010.json` | PC 30 秒高清接收；每张 JPEG 解码及 1920×1080 尺寸检查，757 个不同帧、25.16 fps |
+| `camera0-hd-fault-validation-20261010.json` | 高清版本 SIGSTOP/SIGCONT/SIGKILL、stale/503、停止/重启及 DMA halt |
+| `camera0-linux-10min-validation.json` | 600 秒原采集，599 条每秒样本；错误/空样本/hash 与正常退出 |
+| `linux-camera-deployment.json` | 最终部署时源文件/ELF/模块 hash，另一次正常 60 秒采集指标与后续事项 |
+
+部署清单中的 README hash 指部署当时的板端副本；交付时补充了本仓库文档入口，
+其余已验证 Linux 程序源码未修改。仓库 `validated/` 二进制与该清单一致。
+高清接收测试有复制/忙碌丢弃计数；没有缺失已发布序号不代表没有丢弃采集帧。
+正常 60 秒测试的零丢弃不能覆盖其他测试时段。VDMA 轮转次数也不是无丢帧传感器 FPS。
+原始实验日志、图像及诊断文件保留在本机 `tmp/z19-linux-camera-20261010` 与板端持久日志目录。

+固定材料和检查：
+

+# Z19 standalone 相机历史验证归档
+
+本目录保留此前通过 JTAG 验证的 CAM0 程序及构建输入，用于追溯相机初始化。
+**当前高清实时视频使用 [Linux 实现](../../host/camera_linux/README.md)**，不运行此 ELF。
+standalone 程序需要配套 A53 BSP、FSBL/PS 初始化和相机硬件平台，不能作为 Linux 可执行文件。
+
+## 文件与功能
+
+| 文件/函数 | 功能 |
+|---|---|
+| `src/main.c: transfer/reg_write/reg_read` | PS I2C 传感器寄存器访问及错误检查 |
+| `src/main.c: dma_prepare` | 为既有 VDMA 设置 1920×1080、三帧缓冲及采集参数 |
+| `src/main.c: main` | 初始化 CAM0、手动镜头位置，更新 DDR 帧与供 JTAG 读取的全局状态 |
+| `src/sensor_table.h` | 历史成功使用的 89 项 IMX214 寄存器表 |
+| `camera.ld` | 对应 A53 standalone 链接地址与段布局 |
+| `build.ps1` | 使用已有 BSP/GCC，在全新目录编译 ELF/map 并生成 hash 清单 |
+| `build/validated-live-v2/` | 与这里源码对应的历史 live_v2 ELF、hash 和 JTAG 测量结果 |
+| `build/archive-check/` | 更早的独立 ELF/map/符号归档，不能与 live_v2 混用 |
+
+原输入逐字节保留，不为补充说明改写已经成功的源文件；功能说明放在本文件。
+目录内 `.gitattributes` 仅对这些历史输入保留换行和空白，避免 clone 后 hash 变化。
+
+## 验证边界
+
+live_v2 曾取得真实 1080p 采集图像，JTAG 小预览约 1.3 fps（80 帧、约 57.22 秒）。
+这不是 Linux 1080p MJPEG 的约 25 fps 指标。第二路曾超时，未宣称双路成功。
+历史 ELF SHA256 为 `7d41ee6e72f7f7f1c7b8a501ad2b9c24c4e28670a50aba6732e2addcb7e9f232`。
+`archive-check` 的 ELF 为另一份二进制；其符号地址只用于对应 ELF。
+重编译会受工具/BSP/调试源路径影响，不承诺重建 ELF 与历史 ELF 字节相同。
+
+## 编译
+
+已有 BSP 必须来自配套 [camera.xsa](../camera_hw/validated/camera.xsa) 的 A53 standalone domain；
+准备 Vitis 平台/BSP 后，指定自己的路径。例子使用本机已经存在的 Vitis 2020.1 工具与 BSP：
+
+```powershell
+& F:/Amazing_Hand/fpga/camera_baremetal/build.ps1 `
+  -BspDirectory F:/z19-camera-baremetal-20261006-204935/platform/camera_hw/psu_cortexa53_0/standalone_domain/bsp/psu_cortexa53_0 `
+  -GccPath F:/Xilinx/Vitis/2020.1/gnu/aarch64/nt/aarch64-none/bin/aarch64-none-elf-gcc.exe `
+  -OutputDirectory F:/Amazing_Hand/tmp/camera-baremetal-new-build

+# Build the archived standalone CAM0 application with an existing Vitis BSP.
+# Inputs are preserved; ELF/map/manifest are written only to a NEW directory.
+[CmdletBinding()]

+    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$BspDirectory,
+    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$GccPath,
+    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$OutputDirectory
+)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+$bsp = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $BspDirectory).Path
+$gcc = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $GccPath).Path
+$output = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($OutputDirectory)
+if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $output) { throw 'Output exists; choose a new directory.' }
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bsp 'include/xparameters.h')) -or
+    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bsp 'lib/libxil.a'))) { throw 'Standalone A53 BSP is incomplete.' }
+$main = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'src/main.c'
+$linker = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'camera.ld'
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $output | Out-Null
+$elf = Join-Path $output 'capture.elf'
+$map = Join-Path $output 'capture.map'
+$compilerArguments = @(
+    '-O2', '-g', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-march=armv8-a',
+    ('-I' + (Join-Path $bsp 'include')), ('-I' + (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'src')),
+    $main, ('-L' + (Join-Path $bsp 'lib')),
+    ('-Wl,-T,' + $linker), ('-Wl,-Map,' + $map),
+    '-Wl,--start-group,-lxil,-lgcc,-lc,--end-group', '-o', $elf
+)
+& $gcc @compilerArguments
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('Standalone compilation failed: ' + $LASTEXITCODE) }
+$manifest = [ordered]@{
+    schema = 1
+    note = 'New standalone build; not the archived JTAG ELF or Linux capture binary. Hardware validation is separate.'
+    elf_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $elf -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+    source_sha256 = [ordered]@{
+        'src/main.c' = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $main -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+        'src/sensor_table.h' = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'src/sensor_table.h') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+        'camera.ld' = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $linker -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+    }
+    bsp_library_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bsp 'lib/libxil.a') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+}
+$manifestPath = Join-Path $output 'manifest.json'
+[IO.File]::WriteAllText($manifestPath, ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4) + [Environment]::NewLine, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+Write-Output ('STANDALONE_BUILD_COMPLETE: ' + $elf)

+# Z19 已验证相机硬件平台
+
+本目录归档实际 Linux 相机 0 使用的硬件文件，以及学长提供的四路相机工程输入。
+设备 `xczu19eg-ffvc1760-2-i`，原工程为 **Vivado 2020.2_AR75986**。
+归档没有修改原 BD、XDC、RTL、IP 参数或供应方文件。
+
+## 内容与功能
+
+| 路径 | 功能/用途 |
+|---|---|
+| `validated/camera.xsa` | 已使用的平台导出；用于核对 PS/PL 地址、时钟和 Vitis standalone BSP |
+| `validated/design_1_wrapper.bit` | Linux/JTAG 相机实测使用的同一 bit，保留可部署基线 |
+| `project/mipi_dp.xpr` | 原始工程配置快照，含历史外部路径；不是可移植启动入口 |
+| `project/mipi_dp.srcs/.../design_1.bd` | PS、四路 CSI、Bayer/Gamma、VDMA、AXI、时钟复位和地址配置 |
+| `project/mipi_dp.srcs/constrs_1/new/*.xdc` | 原工程使用的五份板级约束，保留全部原值 |
+| `project/repo/mipi/` | BD 实际依赖的 CSI、Digilent Bayer/Gamma 三个自定义 IP及全部 fileset 输入 |
+| `project/.../*.xci` | 原 IP 配置，包括生成/派生参数；不自动修正六帧/三帧差异 |
+| `scripts/create_project.tcl` | 将输入复制到新目录，再创建可编辑工程；不综合、不升级 IP、不下载 |
+| `manifest.json` | 输入分组、来源、逐文件 SHA256 与已验证 bit 的边界 |
+
+不归档 Vivado cache/run/DCP、仿真波形、RDMA/ERNIC 未使用 IP或系统镜像。
+供应方源文件和版权注释逐字节保留；Digilent 核的 MIT 声明在对应 VHDL 中。
+ALINX/Xilinx 等供应方文件保留各自来源与原有声明，不将其标为本项目原创 Apache 代码。
+
+## 已完成与限制
+
+相机 0：真实 1920×1080 图像、Linux 十分钟采集、约 25 fps 1080p 视频、停止/故障恢复通过。
+地址为 VDMA `0xA0060000`、Gamma `0xA0040000`、GPIO `0xA0080000`。
+bit 的 store 索引实际为 0/1/2，部分导出派生元数据写六帧；保留差异并按实测三帧处理。
+不要使用另一份手控制 bit、原 SD 内 PL 或其他平台导出替换此文件。
+
+**本次没有在匹配的 Vivado 2020.2 中重新综合/实现这个源工程。**
+源文件依赖和 hash 已核对；不宣称从归档重建出的 bit 与实测 bit 相同。
+第二路/四路并发、相机自动冷启动、光学质量/标定、手控制集成仍未验收。
+
+## 打开源工程
+
+使用匹配工具，目标目录必须不存在；脚本把 source 和 generated 分开：
+
+```powershell
+vivado -mode batch -source fpga/camera_hw/scripts/create_project.tcl -tclargs F:/Amazing_Hand/tmp/camera-hw-new-build
+```
+
+本机现有 Vivado 2020.1 会被版本检查拒绝，不能通过自动降级或升级 IP 绕过。
+生成工程后应在 2020.2 核对 BD、IP 状态、DRC/时序和 bit，再另行上板验收。
+既有测试可继续使用 `validated/`，无需重新综合。
+
+## Linux firmware 转换
+
+在新建临时目录复制 `validated/design_1_wrapper.bit` 为 `camera.bit`，创建 BIF：
+
+```text
+all:
+{
+  [destination_device=pl] camera.bit
+}
+```
+
+运行已有 Bootgen：`bootgen -image camera.bif -arch zynqmp -process_bitstream bin`。
+raw bin 预期 SHA256：`e25e9bc7fd4c2008c7a198a91bc4937716b333259d08da7ed777d8ffe9b3384b`。
+只在驱动无占用、配套检查通过后使用仓库 loader 加载；操作见
+[相机快速操作](../../docs/fpga/camera_quickstart.md)。

+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// frame_event_counter.v
+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+//
+// Filename        : frame_event_counter.v
+// Version         : v1.0
+// Description     : Frame event counter with timestamp capture. Counts rising
+//                   edges of a composite trigger signal and latches the global
+//                   timer value at each event. The trigger input can be driven
+//                   by a single signal or by an external AND of multiple
+//                   signals — the module simply detects the rising edge.
+//
+//                   Outputs frame_num and frame_ts are updated synchronously
+//                   on each trigger event and remain stable until the next.
+//
+// Verilog-Standard: Verilog-2001
+//
+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Port summary:
+//
+//   clk         : clock (same domain as global_cnt source)
+//   rstn        : active-low synchronous reset
+//   trig        : trigger input (rising edge detected)
+//   global_cnt  : 64-bit free-running counter from pipeline_latency_timer
+//   frame_num   : 32-bit frame counter (0 after reset, +1 per trigger)
+//   frame_ts    : 64-bit timestamp latched at the most recent trigger edge
+//   frame_pulse : single-cycle pulse on each trigger edge (for daisy-chain)
+//
+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+`timescale 1ps/1ps
+
+module frame_event_counter #(
+    parameter C_NUM_TS_CH    = 8   // Number of trigger input signals
+)(
+    input  wire        clk,
+    input  wire        rstn,
+
+    // Trigger inputs — all signals are ANDed internally.
+    // Rising edge of the AND result increments frame_num and latches timestamp.
+    input  wire [C_NUM_TS_CH-1:0] trig,
+
+    // Global free-running counter from pipeline_latency_timer
+    input  wire [63:0] global_cnt,
+
+    // Outputs
+    output reg  [31:0] frame_num,    // current frame number
+    output reg  [63:0] frame_ts,     // timestamp of latest trigger
+    output reg         frame_pulse   // single-cycle pulse on trigger edge
+);
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Internal AND of all trigger inputs, then rising-edge detection
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+wire trig_and = &trig;   // all bits ANDed
+
+reg trig_and_d;
+
+always @(posedge clk) begin
+    if (~rstn)
+        trig_and_d <= 1'b0;
+    else
+        trig_and_d <= trig_and;
+end
+
+wire trig_rise = trig_and & ~trig_and_d;
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Frame counter and timestamp latch
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+always @(posedge clk) begin
+    if (~rstn) begin
+        frame_num   <= 32'd0;
+        frame_ts    <= 64'd0;
+        frame_pulse <= 1'b0;
+    end else begin
+        frame_pulse <= 1'b0;           // default: no pulse
+

+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// pipeline_latency_timer.v
+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+//
+// Filename        : pipeline_latency_timer.v
+// Version         : v1.0
+// Description     : Global free-running 64-bit counter with multi-channel
+//                   ordered timestamp capture with skip support. Triggers
+//                   are captured in order (ch0, ch1, ..., chN-1). If the
+//                   expected channel has not fired but a later channel fires,
+//                   skipped channels are zero-filled and capture continues.
+//                   Timestamps are promoted to AXI-readable registers only
+//                   when the last channel completes the sequence, guaranteeing
+//                   every readout is a complete, ordered set (0 = skipped).
+// Verilog-Standard: Verilog-2001
+//
+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Register Map (AXI4-Lite, 32-bit words):
+//
+//   Offset  | Name          | Access | Description
+//   --------|---------------|--------|-------------------------------------
+//   0x000   | CTRL          | W      | [0]: soft-reset counter (self-clears)
+//   0x004   | CNT_LSB       | R      | global_cnt[31:0]
+//            |               |        | Reading CNT_LSB snapshots CNT_MSB
+//   0x008   | CNT_MSB       | R      | global_cnt[63:32] (from snapshot)
+//   0x00C   | TS_CH0_LSB    | R      | ts_capture[0][31:0]  (0 if skipped)
+//   0x010   | TS_CH0_MSB    | R      | ts_capture[0][63:32] (0 if skipped)
+//   0x014   | TS_CH1_LSB    | R      | ts_capture[1][31:0]  (0 if skipped)
+//   0x018   | TS_CH1_MSB    | R      | ts_capture[1][63:32] (0 if skipped)
+//    ...     |   ...         |        |   ...
+//   0x00C + ch*8 + 0  : TS_CHch_LSB
+//   0x00C + ch*8 + 4  : TS_CHch_MSB
+//
+// With default C_NUM_TS_CH=8, max offset = 0x050.
+// Address space fits in 7 bits; 12-bit AXI addr port provided for flexibility.
+//
+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Usage:
+//   1. Connect clk/rstn (same clock domain as the signals to be measured).
+//   2. Connect each trig[ch] to the pipeline event signal (rising edge captured).
+//   3. Connect global_cnt output to sibling modules that latch their own
+//      timestamps internally (avoids routing trig signals back here).
+//   4. Read timestamps via AXI4-Lite: read CNT_LSB first (snapshots MSB),
+//      then CNT_MSB for atomic 64-bit counter read.
+//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+`timescale 1ps/1ps
+
+(* DowngradeIPIdentifiedWarnings="yes" *)
+module pipeline_latency_timer #(
+    parameter C_NUM_TS_CH    = 8,   // Number of timestamp capture channels
+    parameter C_CLK_FREQ_MHZ = 200  // Clock frequency in MHz (documentation only)
+)(
+    // Clock and Reset (active-low reset)
+    input  wire                     clk,
+    input  wire                     rstn,
+
+    // Timestamp trigger inputs - one per channel.
+    // Timestamp is captured on the RISING EDGE of each trig[ch].
+    input  wire [C_NUM_TS_CH-1:0]  trig,
+
+    // Global counter output for use by sibling modules on the same clock.
+    // Connect to modules that latch their own timestamps independently.
+    output wire [63:0]              global_cnt,
+
+    // AXI4-Lite Slave Interface
+    // Write address channel
+    input  wire [11:0]              s_axi_awaddr,
+    input  wire                     s_axi_awvalid,
+    output reg                      s_axi_awready,
+    // Write data channel
+    input  wire [31:0]              s_axi_wdata,
+    input  wire [3:0]               s_axi_wstrb,
+    input  wire                     s_axi_wvalid,
+    output reg                      s_axi_wready,
+    // Write response channel
+    output reg  [1:0]               s_axi_bresp,
+    output reg                      s_axi_bvalid,
+    input  wire                     s_axi_bready,
+    // Read address channel
+    input  wire [11:0]              s_axi_araddr,
+    input  wire                     s_axi_arvalid,
+    output reg                      s_axi_arready,
+    // Read data channel
+    output reg  [31:0]              s_axi_rdata,
+    output reg  [1:0]               s_axi_rresp,
+    output reg                      s_axi_rvalid,
+    input  wire                     s_axi_rready
+);
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Local parameters
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+localparam ADDR_CTRL      = 12'h000;  // W   : bit[0] = soft-reset
+localparam ADDR_CNT_LSB   = 12'h004;  // R   : counter[31:0]
+localparam ADDR_CNT_MSB   = 12'h008;  // R   : counter[63:32]
+// Channel n LSB: 12'h00C + n*8
+// Channel n MSB: 12'h010 + n*8
+
+localparam RESP_OKAY      = 2'b00;
+localparam RESP_SLVERR    = 2'b10;
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// 64-bit free-running counter
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+reg [63:0] cnt_r;
+reg        soft_rst;   // self-clearing, one-cycle pulse
+
+always @(posedge clk) begin
+    if (~rstn || soft_rst) begin
+        cnt_r <= 64'b0;
+    end else begin
+        cnt_r <= cnt_r + 64'd1;
+    end
+end
+
+assign global_cnt = cnt_r;
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Trigger edge detection and ordered timestamp capture (with skip)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Triggers are captured in order: ch0, ch1, ..., ch(N-1).
+// If the expected channel has NOT fired but a LATER channel fires, the
+// intermediate channels are marked as skipped (timestamp = 0) and capture
+// continues from the later channel. When the last channel fires (or is
+// reached via skip), all shadow values are promoted atomically to
+// ts_capture[], which is what the AXI-Lite read path returns.
+// Software sees 0 for skipped channels and valid timestamps for triggered
+// channels, always in order.
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+reg  [C_NUM_TS_CH-1:0] trig_d;
+reg  [63:0]             ts_capture [0:C_NUM_TS_CH-1]; // AXI-readable (stable)
+reg  [63:0]             ts_shadow  [0:C_NUM_TS_CH-1]; // in-flight capture
+
+// Width of the channel index counter
+localparam CH_IDX_W = (C_NUM_TS_CH > 1) ? $clog2(C_NUM_TS_CH) : 1;
+reg [CH_IDX_W:0] next_ch;  // one extra bit so we can represent C_NUM_TS_CH
+
+integer ch;
+integer k;
+
+// Edge detection
+always @(posedge clk) begin
+    if (~rstn) begin
+        trig_d <= {C_NUM_TS_CH{1'b0}};
+    end else begin
+        trig_d <= trig;
+    end
+end
+
+// Rising-edge flags
+wire [C_NUM_TS_CH-1:0] trig_rise;
+genvar g;
+generate
+    for (g = 0; g < C_NUM_TS_CH; g = g + 1) begin : gen_rise
+        assign trig_rise[g] = trig[g] & ~trig_d[g];
+    end
+endgenerate
+
+// Combinational priority encoder: find lowest triggered channel >= next_ch
+reg [CH_IDX_W:0] found_ch;
+reg               found_valid;
+
+always @(*) begin
+    found_ch    = {(CH_IDX_W+1){1'b0}};
+    found_valid = 1'b0;
+    for (k = 0; k < C_NUM_TS_CH; k = k + 1) begin
+        if (!found_valid && (k >= next_ch) && trig_rise[k]) begin
+            found_ch    = k[CH_IDX_W:0];
+            found_valid = 1'b1;
+        end
+    end
+end
+
+// Ordered capture state machine (with skip support)
+always @(posedge clk) begin
+    if (~rstn || soft_rst) begin
+        next_ch <= {(CH_IDX_W+1){1'b0}};
+        for (ch = 0; ch < C_NUM_TS_CH; ch = ch + 1) begin
+            ts_capture[ch] <= 64'b0;
+            ts_shadow[ch]  <= 64'b0;
+        end
+    end else if (found_valid) begin
+        // Zero-fill skipped channels in shadow
+        for (ch = 0; ch < C_NUM_TS_CH; ch = ch + 1) begin
+            if (ch >= next_ch && ch < found_ch)
+                ts_shadow[ch] <= 64'b0;
+        end
+        // Capture the found channel
+        ts_shadow[found_ch] <= cnt_r;
+
+        if (found_ch == C_NUM_TS_CH - 1) begin
+            // Last channel reached: promote shadow -> capture atomically
+            for (ch = 0; ch < C_NUM_TS_CH; ch = ch + 1) begin
+                if (ch < next_ch)
+                    ts_capture[ch] <= ts_shadow[ch];   // previously captured
+                else if (ch < found_ch)
+                    ts_capture[ch] <= 64'b0;           // skipped
+                else // ch == found_ch == C_NUM_TS_CH-1
+                    ts_capture[ch] <= cnt_r;            // current cycle
+            end
+            next_ch <= {(CH_IDX_W+1){1'b0}};           // restart sequence
+        end else begin
+            next_ch <= found_ch + 1'b1;
+        end
+    end
+end
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// AXI4-Lite Write Channel
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Accept write address and write data simultaneously (both channels together)
+reg  [11:0] wr_addr_r;
+reg  [31:0] wr_data_r;
+
+// Write state: 0=idle, 1=wait for both aw+w, 2=send bresp
+reg [1:0] wr_state;
+localparam WR_IDLE  = 2'd0;
+localparam WR_BRESP = 2'd1;
+
+always @(posedge clk) begin
+    if (~rstn) begin
+        s_axi_awready <= 1'b0;
+        s_axi_wready  <= 1'b0;
+        s_axi_bvalid  <= 1'b0;
+        s_axi_bresp   <= RESP_OKAY;
+        soft_rst      <= 1'b0;
+        wr_addr_r     <= 12'b0;
+        wr_data_r     <= 32'b0;
+        wr_state      <= WR_IDLE;
+    end else begin
+        soft_rst <= 1'b0;   // default: not asserted
+
+        case (wr_state)
+            WR_IDLE: begin
+                s_axi_awready <= 1'b0;
+                s_axi_wready  <= 1'b0;
+                s_axi_bvalid  <= 1'b0;
+                if (s_axi_awvalid && s_axi_wvalid) begin
+                    // Capture address and data
+                    wr_addr_r     <= s_axi_awaddr;
+                    wr_data_r     <= s_axi_wdata;
+                    s_axi_awready <= 1'b1;
+                    s_axi_wready  <= 1'b1;
+                    wr_state      <= WR_BRESP;
+                end
+            end
+
+            WR_BRESP: begin
+                s_axi_awready <= 1'b0;
+                s_axi_wready  <= 1'b0;
+
+                // Decode write target
+                if (wr_addr_r == ADDR_CTRL) begin
+                    if (wr_data_r[0]) begin
+                        soft_rst <= 1'b1;   // reset counter
+                    end
+                    s_axi_bresp <= RESP_OKAY;
+                end else begin
+                    s_axi_bresp <= RESP_SLVERR; // all other addresses read-only
+                end
+
+                s_axi_bvalid <= 1'b1;
+
+                if (s_axi_bvalid && s_axi_bready) begin
+                    s_axi_bvalid <= 1'b0;
+                    wr_state     <= WR_IDLE;
+                end
+            end
+
+            default: wr_state <= WR_IDLE;
+        endcase
+    end
+end
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// AXI4-Lite Read Channel
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Snapshot MSB when LSB is read for atomic 64-bit access
+reg [31:0] cnt_msb_snap;
+
+reg [1:0] rd_state;
+localparam RD_IDLE  = 2'd0;
+localparam RD_DATA  = 2'd1;
+
+always @(posedge clk) begin
+    if (~rstn) begin
+        s_axi_arready  <= 1'b0;
+        s_axi_rvalid   <= 1'b0;
+        s_axi_rdata    <= 32'b0;
+        s_axi_rresp    <= RESP_OKAY;
+        cnt_msb_snap   <= 32'b0;
+        rd_state       <= RD_IDLE;
+    end else begin
+        case (rd_state)
+            RD_IDLE: begin
+                s_axi_arready <= 1'b0;
+                s_axi_rvalid  <= 1'b0;
+                if (s_axi_arvalid) begin
+                    s_axi_arready <= 1'b1;
+                    rd_state      <= RD_DATA;
+
+                    // Decode read address and drive rdata
+                    if (s_axi_araddr == ADDR_CNT_LSB) begin
+                        // Snapshot MSB atomically with LSB read
+                        s_axi_rdata  <= cnt_r[31:0];
+                        cnt_msb_snap <= cnt_r[63:32];
+                        s_axi_rresp  <= RESP_OKAY;
+                    end else if (s_axi_araddr == ADDR_CNT_MSB) begin
+                        s_axi_rdata  <= cnt_msb_snap;
+                        s_axi_rresp  <= RESP_OKAY;
+                    end else begin
+                        // Check timestamp channel addresses
+                        s_axi_rdata <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF;   // default: bad address
+                        s_axi_rresp <= RESP_SLVERR;
+
+                        // Use a for-loop to decode channel addresses.
+                        // Synthesises to a priority mux.
+                        begin : addr_decode
+                            integer n;
+                            for (n = 0; n < C_NUM_TS_CH; n = n + 1) begin
+                                if (s_axi_araddr == (12'h00C + n * 8)) begin
+                                    s_axi_rdata <= ts_capture[n][31:0];
+                                    s_axi_rresp <= RESP_OKAY;
+                                end else if (s_axi_araddr == (12'h010 + n * 8)) begin
+                                    s_axi_rdata <= ts_capture[n][63:32];
+                                    s_axi_rresp <= RESP_OKAY;
+                                end
+                            end
+                        end
+                    end
+                end
+            end
+
+            RD_DATA: begin
+                s_axi_arready <= 1'b0;
+                s_axi_rvalid  <= 1'b1;
+                if (s_axi_rvalid && s_axi_rready) begin
+                    s_axi_rvalid <= 1'b0;
+                    rd_state     <= RD_IDLE;
+                end
+            end
+
+            default: rd_state <= RD_IDLE;
+        endcase
+    end
+end
+
+endmodule

+//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

+//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+
+// ============================================================
+// AXI-Stream Pixel Counter + Frame Rate Monitor
+// ������֤ MIPI CSI-2 ����ͷ����ֱ��ʼ�֡��
+//
+// �ӿ�˵��:
+//   - ��׼ AXI-Stream Slave �ӿ� (tvalid/tready/tdata/tuser/tlast)
+//   - tuser: ֡��ʼ��־ (SOF, Start of Frame)
+//   - tlast: �н�����־ (EOL, End of Line)
+//
+// ֡�ʲ���ԭ��:
+//   ������֡ SOF ֮���ʱ�������� = frame_period
+//   fps = CLK_FREQ_HZ / frame_period
+//   Ϊ���⸡��, ��� fps_x100 = CLK_FREQ_HZ * 100 / frame_period
+//   ʾ��: CLK_FREQ_HZ=100_000_000, frame_period=3_333_333
+//         fps_x100 = 3000 �� ʵ��֡�� 30.00 fps
+//
+// ILA ��ȡ����:
+//   fps_x100 = {fps_x100_hi, fps_x100_lo}
+//   ʵ��֡�� = fps_x100 / 100
+// ============================================================
+
+module axis_pixel_counter #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH    = 40,          // tdata λ��, RAW10 4-lane=40bit
+    parameter CNT_WIDTH     = 16,          // �ֱ���/���м�����λ��
+    parameter FRAME_WIDTH   = 16,          // ֡������λ��
+    parameter CLK_FREQ_HZ   = 100_000_000  // ����ʱ��Ƶ�� Hz
+)(
+    input  wire                   aclk,
+    input  wire                   aresetn,       // ����Ч��λ
+
+    // AXI-Stream Slave (��������, ��������ˮ��)
+    input  wire                   s_axis_tvalid,
+    input  wire                   s_axis_tready,
+    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tdata,
+    input  wire                   s_axis_tuser,  // SOF
+    input  wire                   s_axis_tlast,  // EOL
+
+    // ---- �ֱ���ͳ�� ----
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   col_cnt,
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   row_cnt,
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   width_latch,
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   height_latch,
+
+    // ---- ֡��ͳ�� (32-bit ��ߵ�16, ���� ILA probe ����) ----
+    //   frame_period = ���� SOF ���ʱ����
+    //   fps_x100     = ֡�� �� 100 (����), ������ ��100 ��ʵ�� fps
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   frame_period_lo,
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   frame_period_hi,
+
+    // ---- ���Լ��� ----
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   pixel_cnt_lo,
+    output reg  [CNT_WIDTH-1:0]   pixel_cnt_hi,
+    output reg  [FRAME_WIDTH-1:0] frame_cnt,
+
+    // ---- ���� (ILA trigger ��) ----
+    output wire                   sof_pulse,
+    output wire                   eol_pulse,
+    output wire                   eof_pulse
+);
+
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    // ���� & ����
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    wire handshake = s_axis_tvalid & s_axis_tready;
+    assign sof_pulse = handshake & s_axis_tuser;
+    assign eol_pulse = handshake & s_axis_tlast;
+    assign eof_pulse = sof_pulse;
+
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    // �м�����
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        if (!aresetn)
+            col_cnt <= 0;
+        else if (handshake) begin
+            if (s_axis_tuser || s_axis_tlast)
+                col_cnt <= 0;
+            else
+                col_cnt <= col_cnt + 1'b1;
+        end
+    end
+
+    // �п�����
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        if (!aresetn)
+            width_latch <= 0;
+        else if (eol_pulse)
+            width_latch <= col_cnt + 1'b1;
+    end
+
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    // �м�����
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        if (!aresetn)
+            row_cnt <= 0;
+        else if (handshake) begin
+            if (s_axis_tuser)
+                row_cnt <= 0;
+            else if (s_axis_tlast)
+                row_cnt <= row_cnt + 1'b1;
+        end
+    end
+
+    // ֡������
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        if (!aresetn)
+            height_latch <= 0;
+        else if (sof_pulse)
+            height_latch <= row_cnt + 1'b1;
+    end
+
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    // ֡������
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        if (!aresetn)
+            frame_cnt <= 0;
+        else if (sof_pulse)
+            frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 1'b1;

+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    // ֡����������
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    reg [31:0] pixel_cnt_r;

+            pixel_cnt_r <= 0;
+        else if (handshake && !s_axis_tuser)
+            pixel_cnt_r <= pixel_cnt_r + 1'b1;

+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        pixel_cnt_lo <= pixel_cnt_r[15:0];
+        pixel_cnt_hi <= pixel_cnt_r[31:16];
+    end

+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+    // ֡�ʲ���
+    //
+    // ����:
+    //   1. free_cnt: �������� 32-bit ������, ȫ�̵���

+    //   3. ����λ���̳������� fps_x100 = CLK*100 / frame_period
+    //      ������ 32 ��ʱ���������, �������һ֡��ʼǰ���ȶ�
+    // ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    // �������м�����
+    reg [31:0] free_cnt;
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        if (!aresetn) free_cnt <= 0;
+        else          free_cnt <= free_cnt + 1'b1;
+    end
+
+    // ֡���ڲ���
+    reg [31:0] sof_ts;          // ��һ֡ SOF ʱ���
+    reg [31:0] frame_period_r;
+    reg        fp_valid;        // ��һ֡����1, �˺� frame_period_r ��Ч
+
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        if (!aresetn) begin
+            sof_ts         <= 0;
+            frame_period_r <= 0;
+            fp_valid       <= 0;
+        end else if (sof_pulse) begin
+            sof_ts   <= free_cnt;
+            fp_valid <= 1'b1;
+            if (fp_valid)
+                frame_period_r <= free_cnt - sof_ts;
+        end
+    end
+
+    always @(posedge aclk) begin
+        frame_period_lo <= frame_period_r[15:0];
+        frame_period_hi <= frame_period_r[31:16];
+    end
+
+endmodule

+/*
+ * frame_ptr_trigger.v - ָ֡��仯���ģ��
+ * 
+ * ���ܣ���� s2mm_frame_ptr_out �仯�����������ÿ��ȵ�����
+ * ���� VDMA ֡��ɴ���
+ */
+
+module frame_ptr_trigger #(
+    parameter PULSE_WIDTH = 4,          // ������ȣ�ʱ����������
+    parameter PTR_WIDTH   = 6           // ָ֡�����
+)(
+    input  wire                  clk,
+    input  wire                  rst_n,
+    input  wire [PTR_WIDTH-1:0]  frame_ptr_in,    // s2mm_frame_ptr_out
+    output reg                   frame_done_pulse, // ֡����������
+    output reg  [PTR_WIDTH-1:0]  frame_ptr_out
+);
+
+    // �Ĵ���һ�ĵ�ָ֡��ֵ
+    reg [PTR_WIDTH-1:0] frame_ptr_d1;
+    
+    // ���������
+    reg [$clog2(PULSE_WIDTH+1)-1:0] pulse_cnt;
+    
+    // �仯���
+    wire ptr_changed;
+    assign ptr_changed = (frame_ptr_in != frame_ptr_d1);
+
+    // �Ĵ�ָ֡��
+    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+        if (!rst_n) begin
+            frame_ptr_d1 <= {PTR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
+        end else begin
+            frame_ptr_d1 <= frame_ptr_in;
+        end
+    end
+
+    // ��������
+    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+        if (!rst_n) begin
+            pulse_cnt <= 0;
+            frame_done_pulse <= 1'b0;
+        end else begin
+            if (ptr_changed) begin
+                // ��⵽�仯����ʼ��������
+                pulse_cnt <= PULSE_WIDTH - 1;
+                frame_done_pulse <= 1'b1;
+            end else if (pulse_cnt > 0) begin
+                // �������
+                pulse_cnt <= pulse_cnt - 1;
+                frame_done_pulse <= 1'b1;
+            end else begin
+                // �������
+                frame_done_pulse <= 1'b0;
+            end
+        end
+    end
+
+    always @(posedge clk) begin
+        frame_ptr_out <= frame_ptr_in;
+    end
+
+endmodule

+--
+-- Purpose:
+-- This component is line buffer implemented in Block RAM. Its width is defined
+-- by kLineBufferWidth generic parameter.
+--  
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+library IEEE;
+use IEEE.STD_LOGIC_1164.all;
+use IEEE.NUMERIC_STD.ALL;
+
+entity LineBuffer is
+generic (kLineBufferWidth: integer := 4096);
+port (
+  PixelClk: in STD_LOGIC;
+  pWriteEnable: in STD_LOGIC;
+  pWriteAddr: in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR(11 downto 0);
+  pWriteData: in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR(9 downto 0);
+  pReadEnable: in STD_LOGIC;
+  pReadAddr: in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR(11 downto 0);
+  pReadData: out STD_LOGIC_VECTOR(9 downto 0)
+);
+end LineBuffer;
+
+architecture rtl of LineBuffer is
+type LineBuffer_t is array ((kLineBufferWidth-1) downto 0) of STD_LOGIC_VECTOR(9 downto 0);
+signal pLineBuffer : LineBuffer_t;
+
+attribute block_ram : boolean;
+attribute block_ram of pLineBuffer : signal is TRUE;
+
+begin
+
+process (PixelClk)
+begin
+  if rising_edge(PixelClk) then
+    if pWriteEnable = '1' then
+      pLineBuffer(to_integer(unsigned(pWriteAddr))) <= pWriteData;
+    end if;
+    if pReadEnable = '1' then
+      pReadData <= pLineBuffer(to_integer(unsigned(pReadAddr)));
+    end if;
+  end if;
+end process;
+
+end rtl;

+library IEEE;
+use IEEE.STD_LOGIC_1164.ALL;

+library UNISIM;

+
+--MIPI CSI-2 Rx 4 lane link layer

+--Licensed under the MIT License
+
+--This combines the clock and data PHYs; byte aligners and word aligner to
+--form the lower levels of the CSI Rx link layer
+
+entity csi_rx_4_lane_link is
+  generic(
+    fpga_series : string := "ULTRASCALE_PLUS";  --FPGA series, 7SERIES or VIRTEX6 or ULTRASCALE or ULTRASCALE_PLUS
+
+    dphy_term_en : boolean := true;
+
+    d0_invert : boolean := false;
+    d1_invert : boolean := false;
+    d2_invert : boolean := false;
+    d3_invert : boolean := false;
+
+    d0_skew : natural := 0;
+    d1_skew : natural := 0;
+    d2_skew : natural := 0;
+    d3_skew : natural := 0;
+
+    generate_idelayctrl : boolean := false
+  );
+  port(
+    dphy_clk : in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (1 downto 0); --clock lane (1 is P, 0 is N)
+    dphy_d0 : in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (1 downto 0); --data lanes (1 is P, 0 is N)
+    dphy_d1 : in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (1 downto 0);
+    dphy_d2 : in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (1 downto 0);
+    dphy_d3 : in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (1 downto 0);
+    ref_clock : in STD_LOGIC; --reference clock for clock detection and IDELAYCTRLs (nominally ~200MHz)
+    reset : in STD_LOGIC; --active high synchronous reset in
+    enable : in STD_LOGIC; --active high enable out
+    wait_for_sync : in STD_LOGIC; --sync wait signal from packet handler
+    packet_done : in STD_LOGIC; --packet done signal from packet handler
+    reset_out : out STD_LOGIC; --reset output based on clock detection
+    word_clock : out STD_LOGIC; --divided word clock output
+    word_data : out STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (31 downto 0); --aligned word data output
+    word_valid : out STD_LOGIC --whether or not above data is synced and aligned
+  );
+end csi_rx_4_lane_link; 
+
+architecture Behavioral of csi_rx_4_lane_link is
+
+  signal ddr_bit_clock : std_logic;
+  signal ddr_bit_clock_b : std_logic;
+  signal word_clock_int : std_logic;
+  signal serdes_reset : std_logic;
+
+  signal deser_data : std_logic_vector(31 downto 0);
+  signal deser_data_rev : std_logic_vector(31 downto 0);
+
+  signal byte_align_data : std_logic_vector(31 downto 0);
+  signal byte_valid : std_logic_vector(3 downto 0);
+  signal word_align_data : std_logic_vector(31 downto 0);
+
+  signal byte_packet_done : std_logic;
+  
+  signal rdy : std_logic ;
+
+begin
+
+  clkphy : entity work.csi_rx_hs_clk_phy
+    generic map(
+      series => fpga_series,
+      term_en => dphy_term_en)
+    port map(
+      dphy_clk => dphy_clk,
+      reset => reset,
+      ddr_bit_clock => ddr_bit_clock,
+      ddr_bit_clock_b => ddr_bit_clock_b,
+      byte_clock => word_clock_int);
+
+  clkdet : entity work.csi_rx_clock_det
+    port map(
+      ref_clock => ref_clock,
+      ext_clock => word_clock_int,
+      enable => enable,
+      reset_in => reset,
+      reset_out => serdes_reset);
+
+
+  d0phy : entity work.csi_rx_hs_lane_phy
+    generic map(
+      series => fpga_series,
+      invert => d0_invert,
+      term_en => dphy_term_en,
+      delay => d0_skew)
+    port map (
+      ddr_bit_clock => ddr_bit_clock,
+      ddr_bit_clock_b => ddr_bit_clock_b,
+      byte_clock => word_clock_int,
+      enable => enable,
+      reset => serdes_reset,
+      dphy_hs => dphy_d0,
+      deser_out => deser_data(7 downto 0)
+      );
+
+  d1phy : entity work.csi_rx_hs_lane_phy
+    generic map(
+      series => fpga_series,
+      invert => d1_invert,
+      term_en => dphy_term_en,
+      delay => d1_skew)
+    port map (
+      ddr_bit_clock => ddr_bit_clock,
+      ddr_bit_clock_b => ddr_bit_clock_b,
+      byte_clock => word_clock_int,
+      enable => enable,
+      reset => serdes_reset,
+      dphy_hs => dphy_d1,
+      deser_out => deser_data(15 downto 8)
+      );
+
+  d2phy : entity work.csi_rx_hs_lane_phy
+    generic map(
+      series => fpga_series,
+      invert => d2_invert,
+      term_en => dphy_term_en,
+      delay => d2_skew)
+    port map (
+      ddr_bit_clock => ddr_bit_clock,
+      ddr_bit_clock_b => ddr_bit_clock_b,
+      byte_clock => word_clock_int,
+      enable => enable,
+      reset => serdes_reset,
+      dphy_hs => dphy_d2,
+      deser_out => deser_data(23 downto 16)
+      );
+
+  d3phy : entity work.csi_rx_hs_lane_phy
+    generic map(
+      series => fpga_series,
+      invert => d3_invert,
+      term_en => dphy_term_en,
+      delay => d3_skew)
+    port map (
+      ddr_bit_clock => ddr_bit_clock,
+      ddr_bit_clock_b => ddr_bit_clock_b,
+      byte_clock => word_clock_int,
+      enable => enable,
+      reset => serdes_reset,
+      dphy_hs => dphy_d3,
+      deser_out => deser_data(31 downto 24)     
+      );
+
+  gen_bytealign : for i in 0 to 3 generate
+      ba : entity work.csi_rx_byte_align
+            port map (
+              clock => word_clock_int,
+              reset => serdes_reset,
+              enable => enable,
+              deser_in => deser_data((8*i) + 7 downto 8 * i),
+              wait_for_sync => wait_for_sync,
+              packet_done => byte_packet_done,
+              valid_data => byte_valid(i),
+              data_out => byte_align_data((8*i) + 7 downto 8 * i));

+
+  wordalign : entity work.csi_rx_word_align
+    port map (
+      word_clock => word_clock_int,
+      reset => serdes_reset,
+      enable => enable,
+      packet_done => packet_done,
+      wait_for_sync => wait_for_sync,
+      packet_done_out => byte_packet_done,
+      word_in => byte_align_data,
+      valid_in => byte_valid,
+      word_out => word_align_data,
+      valid_out => word_valid);
+
+  word_clock <= word_clock_int;
+  word_data <= word_align_data;
+  reset_out <= serdes_reset;
+
+  gen_idctl : if generate_idelayctrl generate
+    idctrl : entity work.csi_rx_idelayctrl_gen
+      port map(
+        ref_clock => ref_clock,
+        reset => reset,
+        rdy => rdy
+        );
+  end generate;
+end Behavioral;

+
+--High-Speed D-PHY clock RX PHY for MIPI CSI-2 Rx core
+--Copyright (C) 2016 David Shah
+--Licensed under the MIT License
+
+-- This receives the input clock and produces both real and complement DDR bit
+-- clocks and an SDR (i.e. in/4) byte clock for the SERDES and other downstream devices
+
+
+entity csi_rx_hs_clk_phy is
+	 generic (
+    series : string := "ULTRASCALE_PLUS"; --FPGA series, 7SERIES or VIRTEX6 or ULTRASCALE or ULTRASCALE_PLUS
+		term_en : boolean := true
+   );

+     dphy_clk : in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (1 downto 0); --D-PHY clock input; 1 is P, 0 is N
+     reset : in STD_LOGIC; --reset input for BUFR
+     ddr_bit_clock : out STD_LOGIC; --DDR bit clock (i.e. input clock buffered) out
+     ddr_bit_clock_b : out STD_LOGIC; --Inverted DDR bit clock out
+     byte_clock : out STD_LOGIC --SDR byte clock (i.e. input clock / 4) out
+  );
+end csi_rx_hs_clk_phy;
+
+architecture Behavioral of csi_rx_hs_clk_phy is
+signal bit_clock_int_pre : std_logic;
+signal bit_clock_int : std_logic;
+signal bit_clock_b_int : std_logic;
+signal byte_clock_int : std_logic;
+begin
+
+iclkdbuf : IBUFDS
+	port map(
+		O => bit_clock_int_pre,
+		I => dphy_clk(1),
+		IB => dphy_clk(0)
+	);
+	
+gen_v6_7s: if series = "VIRTEX6" or series = "7SERIES" generate
+	iclkbufio: BUFIO
+		port map (
+			O => bit_clock_int,
+			I => bit_clock_int_pre
+		);
+
+
+  bit_clock_b_int <= NOT bit_clock_int;
+
+  clkdiv : BUFR
+		generic map (
+			BUFR_DIVIDE => "4",
+			SIM_DEVICE => series
+		)
+		port map (
+			O => byte_clock_int,
+			CE => '1',
+			CLR => reset,
+			I => bit_clock_int_pre
+		);
+
+  ddr_bit_clock <= bit_clock_int;
+  ddr_bit_clock_b <= bit_clock_b_int;
+  byte_clock <= byte_clock_int;
+  end generate;
+  
+  gen_us: if series = "ULTRASCALE_PLUS"generate
+ 
+     iclkbufio : BUFGCE
+             port map (
+                O => bit_clock_int,   -- 1-bit output: Buffer
+                CE => '1', -- 1-bit input: Buffer enable
+                I => bit_clock_int_pre    -- 1-bit input: Buffer
+             );
+  
+  
+    bit_clock_b_int <= NOT bit_clock_int;
+  
+    clkdiv : BUFGCE_DIV
+       generic map (
+          BUFGCE_DIVIDE => 4,     -- 1-8
+          -- Programmable Inversion Attributes: Specifies built-in programmable inversion on specific pins
+          IS_CE_INVERTED => '0',  -- Optional inversion for CE
+          IS_CLR_INVERTED => '0', -- Optional inversion for CLR
+          IS_I_INVERTED => '0'    -- Optional inversion for I
+       )
+       port map (
+          O => byte_clock_int,     -- 1-bit output: Buffer
+          CE => '1',   -- 1-bit input: Buffer enable
+          CLR => reset, -- 1-bit input: Asynchronous clear
+          I => bit_clock_int_pre      -- 1-bit input: Buffer
+       );
+  
+    ddr_bit_clock <= bit_clock_int;
+    ddr_bit_clock_b <= bit_clock_b_int;
+    byte_clock <= byte_clock_int;
+    end generate;
+  
+end Behavioral;

+library IEEE;
+use IEEE.STD_LOGIC_1164.ALL;
+use IEEE.NUMERIC_STD.ALL;
+
+library UNISIM;
+use UNISIM.VComponents.all;
+
+--High-Speed D-PHY lane RX PHY for MIPI CSI-2 Rx core
+--Copyright (C) 2016 David Shah
+--Licensed under the MIT License
+
+--This entity handles input skew compensation and deserialisation for the
+--CSI data input lanes. Output is has arbitrary alignment which must be fixed later on
+--in the processing chain
+entity csi_rx_hs_lane_phy is
+generic(
+  series : string := "ULTRASCALE_PLUS"; --FPGA series, 7SERIES or VIRTEX6 or ULTRASCALE or ULTRASCALE_PLUS
+  invert : boolean := false; --Whether or not to invert output (i.e. if pairs are swapped)
+  term_en : boolean := true; --Whether or not to enable internal input termination
+  delay : natural --IDELAY delay value for skew compensation
+);
+
+port (
+  ddr_bit_clock : in STD_LOGIC; --true and complement DDR bit clocks, buffered from D-PHY clock
+  ddr_bit_clock_b : in STD_LOGIC;
+  byte_clock : in STD_LOGIC; --byte clock; i.e. input clock /4
+  enable : in STD_LOGIC; --active high enable for SERDES
+  reset : in STD_LOGIC; --reset, latched internally to byte clock
+  dphy_hs : in STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (1 downto 0); --lane input, 1 is P, 0 is N
+  deser_out : out STD_LOGIC_VECTOR (7 downto 0)--deserialised byte output
+);
+
+end csi_rx_hs_lane_phy;
+
+architecture Behavioral of csi_rx_hs_lane_phy is
+signal reset_lat : std_logic; --reset synchronised to byte clock
+signal in_se : std_logic; --input after differential buffer
+signal in_delayed : std_logic; --input after deskew
+
+--for Virtex-6 devices where we cascade two ISERDESs
+signal shift_1 : std_logic;
+signal shift_2 : std_logic;
+
+signal serdes_out_int : std_logic_vector(7 downto 0);
+--for Ultrascale bit ordering
+signal serdes_out : std_logic_vector(7 downto 0);
+
+begin
+
+  process(byte_clock)
+  begin
+  if rising_edge(byte_clock) then
+      reset_lat <= reset;
+  end if;
+  end process;
+
+  inbuf : IBUFDS
+    port map(
+        O => in_se,
+        I => dphy_hs(1),
+        IB => dphy_hs(0));
+
+  --Ultrascale+ specific blocks
+  gen_us : if series = "ULTRASCALE_PLUS" generate
+  
+   indelay : IDELAYE3
+     generic map (
+        CASCADE => "NONE",          -- Cascade setting (MASTER, NONE, SLAVE_END, SLAVE_MIDDLE)
+        DELAY_FORMAT => "TIME",     -- Units of the DELAY_VALUE (COUNT, TIME)
+        DELAY_SRC => "IDATAIN",     -- Delay input (DATAIN, IDATAIN)
+        DELAY_TYPE => "FIXED",      -- Set the type of tap delay line (FIXED, VARIABLE, VAR_LOAD)
+        DELAY_VALUE => delay,           -- Input delay value setting
+        IS_CLK_INVERTED => '0',     -- Optional inversion for CLK
+        IS_RST_INVERTED => '0',     -- Optional inversion for RST
+        REFCLK_FREQUENCY => 200.0,  -- IDELAYCTRL clock input frequency in MHz (200.0-2667.0)
+        SIM_DEVICE => series, -- Set the device version (ULTRASCALE, ULTRASCALE_PLUS, ULTRASCALE_PLUS_ES1,
+                                    -- ULTRASCALE_PLUS_ES2)
+        UPDATE_MODE => "ASYNC"      -- Determines when updates to the delay will take effect (ASYNC, MANUAL,
+                                    -- SYNC)
+     )
+     port map (
+        CASC_OUT => open,       -- 1-bit output: Cascade delay output to ODELAY input cascade
+        CNTVALUEOUT => open, -- 9-bit output: Counter value output
+        DATAOUT => in_delayed,         -- 1-bit output: Delayed data output
+        CASC_IN => '0',         -- 1-bit input: Cascade delay input from slave ODELAY CASCADE_OUT
+        CASC_RETURN => '0', -- 1-bit input: Cascade delay returning from slave ODELAY DATAOUT
+        CE => '0',                   -- 1-bit input: Active high enable increment/decrement input
+        CLK => byte_clock,                 -- 1-bit input: Clock input
+        CNTVALUEIN => "000000000",   -- 9-bit input: Counter value input
+        DATAIN => '0',           -- 1-bit input: Data input from the logic
+        EN_VTC => '1',           -- 1-bit input: Keep delay constant over VT
+        IDATAIN => in_se,         -- 1-bit input: Data input from the IOBUF
+        INC => '0',                 -- 1-bit input: Increment / Decrement tap delay input
+        LOAD => '0',               -- 1-bit input: Load DELAY_VALUE input
+        RST => '0'                  -- 1-bit input: Asynchronous Reset to the DELAY_VALUE
+     );
+     
+   ideser : ISERDESE3
+       generic map (
+          DATA_WIDTH => 8,            -- Parallel data width (4,8)
+          FIFO_ENABLE => "FALSE",     -- Enables the use of the FIFO
+          FIFO_SYNC_MODE => "FALSE",  -- Enables the use of internal 2-stage synchronizers on the FIFO
+          IS_CLK_B_INVERTED => '0',   -- Optional inversion for CLK_B
+          IS_CLK_INVERTED => '0',     -- Optional inversion for CLK
+          IS_RST_INVERTED => '0',     -- Optional inversion for RST
+          SIM_DEVICE => series        -- Set the device version (ULTRASCALE, ULTRASCALE_PLUS, ULTRASCALE_PLUS_ES1,
+                                      -- ULTRASCALE_PLUS_ES2)
+       )
+       port map (
+          FIFO_EMPTY => open,           -- 1-bit output: FIFO empty flag
+          INTERNAL_DIVCLK => open, -- 1-bit output: Internally divided down clock used when FIFO is
+                                              -- disabled (do not connect)
+    
+          Q => serdes_out,                             -- 8-bit registered output
+          CLK => ddr_bit_clock,                         -- 1-bit input: High-speed clock
+          CLKDIV => byte_clock,                   -- 1-bit input: Divided Clock
+          CLK_B => ddr_bit_clock_b,                     -- 1-bit input: Inversion of High-speed clock CLK
+          D => in_delayed,                             -- 1-bit input: Serial Data Input
+          FIFO_RD_CLK => '0',         -- 1-bit input: FIFO read clock
+          FIFO_RD_EN => '0',           -- 1-bit input: Enables reading the FIFO when asserted
+          RST => reset_lat                          -- 1-bit input: Asynchronous Reset
+       );
+       serdes_out_int <= serdes_out ;
+       
+  end generate;
+
+  --7 series specific blocks
+  gen_7s : if series = "7SERIES" generate
+
+    indelay : IDELAYE2
+      generic map (
+        CINVCTRL_SEL => "FALSE",
+        DELAY_SRC => "IDATAIN",
+        HIGH_PERFORMANCE_MODE  => "TRUE",
+        IDELAY_TYPE => "FIXED",
+        IDELAY_VALUE => delay,
+        REFCLK_FREQUENCY => 200.0,
+        SIGNAL_PATTERN => "DATA",
+        PIPE_SEL => "FALSE"
+        )
+      port map (
+        DATAOUT => in_delayed,
+        DATAIN => '0',
+        C => byte_clock,
+        CE => '0',
+        INC => '0',
+        IDATAIN => in_se,
+        CNTVALUEIN => "00000",
+        CNTVALUEOUT => open,
+        CINVCTRL => '0',
+        LD => '0',
+        LDPIPEEN => '0',
+        REGRST => '0'
+        );
+
+     ideser : ISERDESE2
+     generic map (
+         DATA_RATE => "DDR",
+         DATA_WIDTH => 8,
+         DYN_CLKDIV_INV_EN => "FALSE",
+         DYN_CLK_INV_EN => "FALSE",
+         INIT_Q1 => '0',
+         INIT_Q2 => '0',
+         INIT_Q3 => '0',
+         INIT_Q4 => '0',
+         INTERFACE_TYPE => "NETWORKING",
+         IOBDELAY => "IFD",
+         NUM_CE => 1,
+         OFB_USED => "FALSE",
+         SERDES_MODE => "MASTER",
+         SRVAL_Q1 => '0',
+         SRVAL_Q2 => '0',
+         SRVAL_Q3 => '0',
+         SRVAL_Q4 => '0')
+     port map (
+         O => open,
+         --In the ISERDESE2, Q8 is the oldest bit but in the CSI spec
+         --the MSB is the most recent bit. So we mirror the output
+         Q1 => serdes_out_int(7),
+         Q2 => serdes_out_int(6),
+         Q3 => serdes_out_int(5),
+         Q4 => serdes_out_int(4),
+         Q5 => serdes_out_int(3),
+         Q6 => serdes_out_int(2),
+         Q7 => serdes_out_int(1),
+         Q8 => serdes_out_int(0),
+         SHIFTOUT1 => open,
+         SHIFTOUT2 => open,
+         BITSLIP => '0',
+         CE1 => enable,
+         CE2 => '1',
+         CLKDIVP => '0',
+         CLK => ddr_bit_clock,
+         CLKB => ddr_bit_clock_b,
+         CLKDIV => byte_clock,
+         OCLK => '0',
+         DYNCLKDIVSEL => '0',
+         DYNCLKSEL => '0',
+         D => '0',
+         DDLY => in_delayed,
+         OFB => '0',
+         OCLKB => '0',
+         RST => reset_lat,
+         SHIFTIN1 => '0',
+         SHIFTIN2 => '0'
+     );
+
+  end generate;
+
+
+  --Legacy Virtex-6 specific blocks
+  gen_v6 : if series = "VIRTEX6" generate
+    --Input delay for skew compensation
+    indelay : IODELAYE1
+      generic map (
+        CINVCTRL_SEL           => FALSE,
+        DELAY_SRC              => "I",
+        HIGH_PERFORMANCE_MODE  => TRUE,
+        IDELAY_TYPE            => "FIXED",
+        IDELAY_VALUE           => delay,
+        ODELAY_TYPE            => "FIXED",
+        ODELAY_VALUE           => 0,
+        REFCLK_FREQUENCY       => 200.0,
+        SIGNAL_PATTERN         => "DATA"
+        )
+      port map (
+        DATAOUT                => in_delayed,
+        DATAIN                 => '0',
+        C                      => byte_clock,
+        CE                     => '0',
+        INC                    => '0',
+        IDATAIN                => in_se,
+        ODATAIN                => '0',
+        RST                    => '0',
+        T                      => '1',
+        CNTVALUEIN             => "00000",
+        CNTVALUEOUT            => open,
+        CLKIN                  => '0',
+        CINVCTRL               => '0'
+        );
+
+    --Input deserialisation
+    ideser1 : ISERDESE1
+      generic map (
+        DATA_RATE => "DDR",
+        DATA_WIDTH => 8,
+        DYN_CLKDIV_INV_EN => FALSE,
+        DYN_CLK_INV_EN => FALSE,
+        INIT_Q1 => '0',
+        INIT_Q2 => '0',
+        INIT_Q3 => '0',
+        INIT_Q4 => '0',
+
+        INTERFACE_TYPE => "NETWORKING",
+        IOBDELAY => "IFD",
+        NUM_CE => 2,
+        OFB_USED => FALSE,
+        SERDES_MODE => "MASTER",
+        SRVAL_Q1 => '0',
+        SRVAL_Q2 => '0',
+        SRVAL_Q3 => '0',
+        SRVAL_Q4 => '0'
+
+      )
+      port map(
+        O => open,
+        Q1 => serdes_out_int(7),
+        Q2 => serdes_out_int(6),
+        Q3 => serdes_out_int(5),
+        Q4 => serdes_out_int(4),
+        Q5 => serdes_out_int(3),
+        Q6 => serdes_out_int(2),
+        SHIFTOUT1 => shift_1,
+        SHIFTOUT2 => shift_2,
+        BITSLIP => '0',
+        CE1 => enable,
+        CE2 => enable,
+        CLK => ddr_bit_clock,
+        CLKB => ddr_bit_clock_b,
+        CLKDIV => byte_clock,
+        D => '0',
+        DDLY => in_delayed,
+        DYNCLKDIVSEL => '0',
+        DYNCLKSEL => '0',
+        OCLK => '0',
+        OFB => '0',
+        RST => reset_lat,
+        SHIFTIN1 => '0',
+        SHIFTIN2 => '0');
+
+    ideser2			: ISERDESE1
+      generic map (
+        DATA_RATE => "DDR",
+        DATA_WIDTH => 8,
+        DYN_CLKDIV_INV_EN => FALSE,
+        DYN_CLK_INV_EN => FALSE,
+

+# Z19 Linux camera 0 bench
+
+This directory ports the already demonstrated FL0214/IMX214 camera-0 sequence
+to Linux. It does not configure hand actuators. The unchanged hardware inputs,
+reviewed bit/XSA and provenance are archived in
+[camera_hw](../../fpga/camera_hw/README.md); external originals remain preserved.
+
+The bench profile is tied to the previously tested four-camera XSA bitstream:
+
+- bit SHA256: `28e1e3e7963ff12f57848998cf2695dcca139c3f519c5f020daf90dec4dc35ae`
+- Bootgen raw bin SHA256: `e25e9bc7fd4c2008c7a198a91bc4937716b333259d08da7ed777d8ffe9b3384b`
+- camera 0 VDMA: `0xA0060000`, scalar Digilent gamma: `0xA0040000`, reset GPIO: `0xA0080000`
+- PS I2C0, `/dev/i2c-0`, sensor `0x10`, lens actuator `0x0c`
+- PL clocks approximately 200/100 MHz; PS HP1 interface is 128 bits
+- Linux `5.4.0-xilinx-v2020.2`, AArch64, GCC 9.2.0
+- 1920×1080, BGR DMA bytes inferred from supplied RTL/XSA remap; three owned buffers (page-aligned stride 6221824)
+
+The XSA has conflicting derived `C_NUM_FSTORES=6` and actual configurable
+`c_num_fstores=3` values. The tested bit cycles indices 0/1/2. All six address
+pairs are filled with aliases of allocated memory defensively; consumers use
+only the three observed stores. Do not extrapolate this to another bitstream.
+
+`sensor_table.h` preserves all 89 register/value entries from the tested
+bare-metal `live_v2/src`; only trailing whitespace/newlines were normalized.
+Original SHA256 `e4875d6bf8bec230e173ee97706837ea20d3d6a955f386069a39e48a509a2a5b`;
+repository header SHA256 `136cffb7aedb45659e86a7abb5b5bcd2c772012e8177268d9348dbc857623ebf`.
+The CSI source holds FIFO reset for 200 million byte-clock cycles and delays
+writes for another 100 million. Capture waits up to 30 seconds for real frame
+transitions, then begins measurement. A 500 ms delay was insufficient at first.
+
+## Build on the board
+
+The shipped kernel header tree lacks host tools and generated ARM wrappers.
+Build an isolated copy, preserving `/lib/modules/.../build`:
+
+```sh
+export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
+# Use a new, nonexistent destination; never overwrite an existing build tree.
+cp -a /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build /var/lib/amazinghand/build/kernel-camera-20261010
+K=/var/lib/amazinghand/build/kernel-camera-20261010
+make -C "$K" ARCH=arm64 CROSS_COMPILE= HOSTCC=gcc scripts
+make -C "$K" ARCH=arm64 CROSS_COMPILE= HOSTCC=gcc asm-generic
+make -C "$K" ARCH=arm64 CROSS_COMPILE= HOSTCC=gcc prepare0
+cd /path/to/copied/camera_linux
+make KERNEL_DIR="$K" module
+make capture
+```
+
+Native syncconfig adds only `CONFIG_CC_CAN_LINK` and updates the compiler label;
+it does not change the running kernel. The rebuilt module was actually loaded
+and used to capture frames; vermagic alone is not the validation.
+
+Convert a copy of the reviewed XSA's `design_1_wrapper.bit` with the existing
+Bootgen, using a BIF containing `[destination_device=pl] camera.bit`:
+
+```text
+bootgen -image camera.bif -arch zynqmp -process_bitstream bin
+```
+
+Verify both hashes above, transfer the raw bin into `/lib/firmware`, then run
+the guarded manual loader. It checks hashes, module ABI, active PL users,
+clocks and the relevant PS interface registers before programming.
+
+```sh
+sh /opt/amazinghand/bin/load_z19_camera0.sh \
+  /lib/firmware/amazinghand-camera-28e1e3e7-20261010.bin ./ah_camera0.ko
+./capture_camera0 10 /var/lib/amazinghand/log/NEW_CAPTURE.raw 300
+python3 test_device.py idle
+python3 start_preview.py
+```
+
+On the directly connected PC, run `python host/camera_linux/view_camera.py`
+and open `http://127.0.0.1:8766/`. This loopback viewer forwards only camera
+HTTP routes directly to the board, preserving the PC's existing proxy settings.
+Stop it with Ctrl+C. The board service remains available at
+`http://192.28.14.153:9000/` when the browser can connect directly.
+
+Preview now uses a persistent **1920×1080 MJPEG stream**, with no upscaling
+from the old 320×180 image. A 30-second PC receive test decoded all 757 JPEGs
+at 1920×1080, measured 25.161 frames/s, and found 757 different frames with
+no missing published sequences. This measures received frames, not browser
+rendering or lossless sensor acquisition. Actual rate depends on scene and
+clients; the page displays the measured publishing rate and supports fullscreen.
+Earlier 5 Hz snapshots and 320×180/29.4 Hz streaming are retained as history
+in the bring-up log, not the current resolution.
+Focus 0–1023 is a manual actuator position, not autofocus. No detection model
+or robot-control process runs in this UI.
+The helper detaches the server from SSH and prints a PID/log path; SIGTERM to
+that verified PID stops the server. The capture also checks parent-process
+liveness and stops if its server disappears. It is not an automatic boot service.
+Four copy slices move the complete coherent DMA frame into ordinary RAM;
+two native libjpeg-turbo workers encode BGR directly at quality 85. The board
+already provides libjpeg-turbo 2.0.3 and development headers; no new packages
+were installed. The Python server forwards encoded JPEGs without re-encoding.
+Validate optical color against a known target; haze/focus is not resolved by
+increasing resolution.
+
+Copies begin just after a buffer transition. The complete status/copy/status
+window must be at most 30 ms and the selected store must remain non-writable.
+This bound is specific to the reviewed sensor profile, observed at ~55.6 Hz:
+a complete overwrite and wrap requires at least two periods (~36 ms).
+Do not reuse this bound for faster sensor modes. No mapping/cache properties
+or driver ABI changed. Busy/unsafe/obsolete copies are discarded and counted;
+JPEG workers only read cached copies. Metadata cannot regress in capture time.
+Clients receive the newest published sequence without an application backlog.
+A stale/error/stop closes an existing stream and rejects new frame requests.
+
+Current deployment: `/opt/amazinghand/camera0-linux-hd-20261010`.
+The old package is preserved. To run fault tests without overwriting prior
+evidence, provide `python3 test_preview.py --output /path/to/NEW_RESULT.json`.
+On the PC, `test_stream.py --seconds 30 --output NEW.json --snapshot NEW.jpg`
+checks every received JPEG's resolution, sequence, capture time and delivery
+intervals. It uses PC Pillow; do not install that dependency onto the board.
+A separate 60-second HD run published 1666 frames without copy/busy/obsolete
+discards, stopped DMA normally, joined workers and saved a 6220800-byte raw.
+The service uses a one-hour capture session; press Start again after it ends.
+
+Chinese operating steps: [`camera_quickstart.md`](../../docs/fpga/camera_quickstart.md).
+
+## Ownership and shutdown
+
+- One open owner; unknown ioctls, writable/partial/private/offset mappings are rejected.
+- DMA buffers use `dma_alloc_coherent` and `dma_mmap_coherent`, limited below 4 GiB.
+- File/VMA references prevent unloading the module while buffers are mapped.
+- Normal stop: sensor stream off → VDMA halted → save stable previous store → unmap → close.
+- Last file release, including process death, resets CSI and halts/resets VDMA.
+- If hardware cannot halt, memory is retained, new opens are refused, and a
+  critical message requires power-cycle recovery. It is never returned for reuse
+  while DMA may still access it.
+- Never reprogram PL with this module loaded. Stop the owned capture, check
+  that the device is no longer open/mapped, then `rmmod ah_camera0` first.
+- SD BOOT.BIN/FIT are unchanged. A reboot loads the old baseline PL; manually
+  load this reviewed camera profile again before capturing. Automatic boot and
+  camera cold-start reliability are separate pending acceptance items.
+
+Actual board results and limitations are recorded in
+[`docs/fpga/linux_camera0_bringup.md`](../../docs/fpga/linux_camera0_bringup.md).

+"""Start a detached, local camera preview; never replaces an active server.
+
+Use the returned PID for a deliberate SIGTERM stop. PID/log files are created
+exclusively, preserving any prior run. This does not register an init service.
+"""
+import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+
+def main():
+    package = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    server = package / 'preview_server.py'
+    capture = package / 'capture_camera0'
+    if not server.is_file() or not capture.is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError('camera package incomplete')
+    for process in Path('/proc').iterdir():
+        if not process.name.isdigit():
+            continue
+        try:
+            argv = (process / 'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
+        except OSError:
+            continue
+        if any(value == b'preview_server.py' or value.endswith(b'/preview_server.py') for value in argv):
+            raise RuntimeError('a preview server is already running')

+"""Hardware bench checks for the reviewed driver. Run only on the Z19.
+
+busy: verify exclusive ownership during an existing capture.
+idle: verify ABI, rejected mappings, VMA/module lifetime and stopped DMA.
+"""
+import argparse
+import errno
+import fcntl
+import mmap
+import os
+import struct
+import subprocess
+
+DEVICE = '/dev/ah_camera0'
+INFO = 0x80384101
+STATUS = 0x80104104
+
+
+def expect_busy():
+    try:
+        fd = os.open(DEVICE, os.O_RDONLY)
+    except OSError as error:
+        assert error.errno == errno.EBUSY, error
+        return
+    os.close(fd)
+    raise AssertionError('second open was accepted')
+
+
+def rejected_map(fd, length, prot, flags, offset=0):
+    try:
+        mapped = mmap.mmap(fd, length, flags=flags, prot=prot, offset=offset)
+    except OSError as error:
+        assert error.errno in (errno.EINVAL, errno.EACCES), error
+        return
+    mapped.close()
+    raise AssertionError('invalid mapping was accepted')
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('mode', choices=['busy', 'idle'])
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.mode == 'busy':
+        expect_busy()
+        print('EXCLUSIVE_OPEN_PASS')
+        return
+    fd = os.open(DEVICE, os.O_RDWR)
+    mapped = None
+    try:
+        info = bytearray(56)
+        fcntl.ioctl(fd, INFO, info)
+        a, b, c, frame, stride, total, width, height, count, version, reserved = struct.unpack('<3Q8I', info)
+        assert (frame, width, height, count, version, reserved) == (6220800, 1920, 1080, 3, 1, 0)
+        assert stride % 4096 == 0 and stride >= frame and total == stride * 3
+        assert [b - a, c - b] == [stride, stride]
+        assert 0 < a < c + stride < 2**32
+        status = bytearray(16)
+        fcntl.ioctl(fd, STATUS, status)
+        control, flags, index, hw_version = struct.unpack('<4I', status)
+        assert flags & 1 and not control & 1 and hw_version == 0x62000050
+        try:
+            fcntl.ioctl(fd, 0xdeadbeef, 0)
+        except OSError as error:
+            assert error.errno == errno.ENOTTY
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError('unknown ioctl accepted')
+        rejected_map(fd, total, mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE, mmap.MAP_SHARED)
+        rejected_map(fd, 4096, mmap.PROT_READ, mmap.MAP_SHARED)
+        rejected_map(fd, total, mmap.PROT_READ, mmap.MAP_SHARED, 4096)
+        rejected_map(fd, total, mmap.PROT_READ, mmap.MAP_PRIVATE)
+        expect_busy()
+        mapped = mmap.mmap(fd, total, flags=mmap.MAP_SHARED, prot=mmap.PROT_READ)
+        os.close(fd)
+        fd = -1
+        expect_busy()  # Mapping keeps the file and module alive after fd close.
+        attempt = subprocess.run(['rmmod', 'ah_camera0'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        assert attempt.returncode != 0 and os.path.isdir('/sys/module/ah_camera0')
+        mapped.close()
+        mapped = None
+        fd = os.open(DEVICE, os.O_RDONLY)
+        fcntl.ioctl(fd, STATUS, status)
+        assert struct.unpack('<4I', status)[1] & 1
+        print('ABI_MAPPING_LIFETIME_HALT_PASS')
+    finally:
+        if mapped is not None:
+            mapped.close()
+        if fd >= 0:
+            os.close(fd)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""On-board bench fault injection for an owned preview/capture pair.
+
+Stops/resumes then kills only the uniquely identified capture child. It verifies
+stale/error HTTP responses and driver cleanup, and restarts capture afterwards.
+Run with a live preview server; never use against another deployment profile.
+"""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+
+URL = 'http://192.28.14.153:9000'
+OPENER = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
+
+
+def status():
+    return json.loads(OPENER.open(URL + '/status.json', timeout=5).read())
+
+
+def post(path, data=None):
+    request = urllib.request.Request(URL + '/' + path, json.dumps(data or {}).encode(),
+                                     {'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
+    return json.loads(OPENER.open(request, timeout=5).read())
+
+
+def wait_live():
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    while time.monotonic() - begin < 35:
+        value = status()
+        if value['state'] == 'LIVE':
+            return value
+        if value['state'] == 'ERROR':
+            raise AssertionError(value)
+        time.sleep(.1)
+    raise AssertionError('preview did not become live')
+
+
+def frame_rejected():
+    for path in ('/frame.jpg', '/stream.mjpg'):
+        try:
+            OPENER.open(URL + path, timeout=5)
+        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+            assert error.code == 503
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError('stale frame was served: ' + path)
+
+
+def owned_child():
+    candidates = []
+    for entry in Path('/proc').iterdir():
+        if not entry.name.isdigit():
+            continue
+        try:
+            argv = (entry / 'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
+            if not argv[0].endswith(b'/capture_camera0'):
+                continue
+            parent = int((entry / 'status').read_text().split('PPid:')[1].split()[0])
+            parent_argv = (Path('/proc') / str(parent) / 'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
+            if not any(value.endswith(b'/preview_server.py') or value == b'preview_server.py' for value in parent_argv):
+                continue
+            if not any(os.readlink(str(fd)) == '/dev/ah_camera0' for fd in (entry / 'fd').iterdir()):
+                continue
+            candidates.append(int(entry.name))
+        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
+            continue
+    assert len(candidates) == 1, candidates
+    return candidates[0]
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=Path('/var/lib/amazinghand/log/camera0-preview-fault-validation-20261010.json'))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.output.exists():
+        raise RuntimeError('test output already exists')
+    result = {}
+    wait_live()
+    hashes = []
+    sequences = []
+    for _ in range(12):
+        sequences.append(status()['sequence'])
+        hashes.append(hashlib.sha256(OPENER.open(URL + '/frame.jpg', timeout=5).read()).hexdigest())
+        time.sleep(.25)
+    assert len(set(hashes)) > 8 and sequences[-1] > sequences[0]
+    result['different_jpegs'] = len(set(hashes))
+    pid = owned_child()
+    stream = OPENER.open(URL + '/stream.mjpg', timeout=5)
+    assert stream.headers.get_content_type() == 'multipart/x-mixed-replace'
+    assert stream.readline().strip() == b'--frame'
+    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGSTOP)
+    try:
+        time.sleep(1.2)
+        assert status()['state'] == 'STALE'
+        frame_rejected()
+        remainder = stream.read()
+        stream.close()
+        assert remainder and len(remainder) < 1000000
+        result['existing_stream_closes_on_stale'] = True
+        result['sigstop_stale_503'] = True
+    finally:
+        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGCONT)
+    wait_live()
+    result['sigcont_live'] = True
+    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+    for _ in range(30):
+        if status()['state'] == 'ERROR':
+            break
+        time.sleep(.1)
+    assert status()['state'] == 'ERROR'
+    frame_rejected()
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name('test_device.py')), 'idle'], check=True)
+    result['sigkill_error_503_and_dma_halt'] = True
+    try:
+        post('focus', {'position': 1024})
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+        assert error.code == 400
+        result['invalid_focus_rejected'] = True
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError('invalid focus accepted')
+    post('start')
+    wait_live()
+    result['restart_live'] = True
+    post('stop')
+    assert status()['state'] == 'STOPPED'
+    frame_rejected()
+    result['stop_503'] = True
+    post('start')
+    wait_live()
+    result['final_live'] = True
+    destination = args.output
+    with destination.open('x') as output:
+        json.dump(result, output, indent=2)
+    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""PC receive test for real MJPEG resolution, freshness and delivery rate.
+
+Uses Pillow on the PC to decode every JPEG. Evidence and the first frame are
+created exclusively. This measures received frames, not browser rendering FPS.
+"""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+import urllib.request
+from PIL import Image
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--url', default='http://127.0.0.1:8766')
+    parser.add_argument('--seconds', type=int, default=30)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--snapshot', type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.output.exists() or args.snapshot.exists():
+        raise RuntimeError('evidence destination already exists')
+    if not 1 <= args.seconds <= 600:
+        raise ValueError('duration must be 1..600 seconds')
+    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
+    base = args.url.rstrip('/')
+    for _ in range(90):
+        with opener.open(base + '/status.json', timeout=5) as response:
+            status = json.load(response)
+        if status['state'] == 'LIVE':
+            break
+        if status['state'] == 'ERROR':
+            raise AssertionError(status)
+        time.sleep(.5)
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError('stream did not become live')
+    records = []
+    with opener.open(base + '/stream.mjpg', timeout=6) as response:
+        assert response.headers.get_content_type() == 'multipart/x-mixed-replace'
+        begin = time.perf_counter()
+        while time.perf_counter() - begin < args.seconds:
+            assert response.readline().strip() == b'--frame'
+            headers = {}
+            while True:
+                line = response.readline().strip()
+                if not line:
+                    break
+                key, value = line.decode().split(':', 1)
+                headers[key.lower()] = value.strip()
+            size = int(headers['content-length'])
+            assert 0 < size < 4000000
+            jpeg = response.read(size)
+            stamp = time.perf_counter()
+            assert response.read(2) == b'\r\n'
+            with Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpeg)) as image:
+                image.load()
+                assert image.size == (1920, 1080), image.size
+            sequence = int(headers['x-sequence'])
+            capture = float(headers['x-capture-monotonic'])
+            if records:
+                assert sequence > records[-1]['sequence']
+                assert capture > records[-1]['capture']
+            records.append({'time': stamp, 'sequence': sequence, 'capture': capture,
+                            'bytes': size, 'hash': hashlib.sha256(jpeg).hexdigest()})
+            if len(records) == 1:
+                with args.snapshot.open('xb') as output:
+                    output.write(jpeg)
+    elapsed = records[-1]['time'] - records[0]['time']
+    intervals = sorted(records[i]['time'] - records[i-1]['time'] for i in range(1, len(records)))
+    assert elapsed > 0 and len(records) > 1
+    with opener.open(base + '/status.json', timeout=5) as response:
+        final_status = json.load(response)
+    assert final_status['state'] == 'LIVE'
+    result = {'url': base, 'preview_size': [1920,1080], 'frames': len(records),
+              'elapsed_seconds': elapsed, 'received_fps': (len(records)-1)/elapsed,
+              'published_fps': (records[-1]['sequence']-records[0]['sequence'])/(records[-1]['capture']-records[0]['capture']),
+              'unique_jpegs': len({r['hash'] for r in records}),
+              'missing_sequences': records[-1]['sequence']-records[0]['sequence']+1-len(records),
+              'interval_p95_ms': intervals[int(len(intervals)*.95)]*1000,
+              'max_interval_ms': max(intervals)*1000,
+              'megabits_per_second': sum(r['bytes'] for r in records)*8/elapsed/1e6,
+              'status_before': status, 'status_after': final_status,
+              'every_jpeg_decoded_and_dimensions_checked': True,
+              'sequences_and_capture_times_strictly_increasing': True}
+    with args.output.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as output:
+        json.dump(result, output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
